name: Dewan

categories.label: Completed story tiles (tile points)
categories.labelVi: Điểm thẻ truyện đã hoàn thành
categories.hint: Sum of the point values on your completed story tiles.

categories.label: Fires (on completed story tiles and tucked cards)
categories.labelVi: Lửa (trên thẻ truyện hoàn thành và thẻ úp)

categories.label: Total fires from all sources (for most-fires bonus)
categories.labelVi: Tổng số lửa (để xét thưởng nhiều lửa nhất)
categories.hint: Enter your total fires including the final-camp fire. Most fires: 4 points, all tied players get it. Not added to score itself.

categories.label: Most fires bonus
categories.hint: 4 points to the player(s) with the most fires.

categories.label: Connected camp groups (2+ camps)
categories.hint: 4 points per group of at least 2 connected camps (may span terrains).

categories.label: Berry tokens (board + tucked cards)
categories.labelVi: Quả mọng (thu từ bàn và thẻ úp)
categories.hint: 2 points per berry collected from the board and on tucked cards.

notes: family: set-collection. Tiebreaker not found in sources; unverified against printed rulebook (only BGA scoring summary). mostFires is a rankAward over its own input, so enter the same total in totalFiresForMajority and mostFires if the UI does not link them.
